name: modelmux
description: 多渠道本地模型池网关：把多个渠道汇成一个 OpenAI 兼容端点，对外暴露各渠道真实模型（modelmux CLI）

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui && npm run build --workspace=packages/cli && node scripts/copy-ui.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:contract && npm run verify:storage && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:comments && npm run verify:commits && npm run verify:topology && npm run verify:references && npm run verify:layering && npm run verify:wiring && npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
